description: Defines a templated C++ class WebLinkType for managing WebSocket-like communication channels with serialization, deserialization, and transformation capabilities, including nested classes for handling serialization, deserialization, and link handling.

classes.name: WebLinkType
classes.description: A templated class managing WebSocket-like links with serialization, deserialization, and optional transformation, including nested handler, serializer, and deserializer classes.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits an outbound proxy object into the channel if open.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the communication channel with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the communication channel with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the serializer and deserializer buffers.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the channel is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the channel is closed.

methods.name: IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the channel is suspended.

methods.name: IsClose
methods.description: Checks if the channel is in close state.

methods.name: ResetActivity
methods.description: Resets activity status of the channel.

methods.name: HasActivity
methods.description: Checks if the channel has activity.

methods.name: Allocator
methods.description: Provides access to the allocator used by the deserializer.
